name: Lianxia Xiaopi granules (Chinese herbal formula)
short: One placebo-controlled trial (240 completers, dyspepsia): adverse events did not differ from placebo; types not given. Herbs not listed. No other safety study, and no liver or metal report.
text: Trial: in a multicentre, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial at 11 centres in China in people with functional dyspepsia, which set out to study safety as well as efficacy, 240 participants completed the trial (160 on the granules, 80 on placebo), and the safety analysis found no significant differences in adverse events between the two groups; the abstract does not give event numbers or types. This is the only study of the granules found. The abstract does not list the herbs. PubMed searches found no report of liver injury, kidney injury or heavy-metal contamination naming these granules. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
